# keycard_policy_schemas (Data Source)

Lists the Cedar policy schema versions available in a zone. Policy schemas define the entity model (users, applications, resources) that Cedar policies are validated against; they are managed by the Keycard platform. Unlike `keycard_policies` and `keycard_policy_sets`, archived schema versions are included; filter client-side on `status != "archived"` if you want only active ones.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all Cedar policy schema versions available in a zone
data "keycard_policy_schemas" "all" {
  zone_id = keycard_zone.example.id
}

# List only the zone's default schema
data "keycard_policy_schemas" "default" {
  zone_id    = keycard_zone.example.id
  is_default = true
}

output "schema_versions" {
  value = data.keycard_policy_schemas.all.schemas[*].version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_id` (String) The zone to list policy schemas from.

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean) Optional filter by default status. When `true`, returns only the zone's default schema; when `false`, only non-default schemas. Omit to return all schemas.

### Read-Only

- `schemas` (Attributes List) The schema versions matching the filter, or all schema versions in the zone when no filter is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schemas))

<a id="nestedatt--schemas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schemas`

Read-Only:

- `archived_at` (String) Timestamp when the schema version was archived (RFC 3339). Null unless archived.
- `cedar_schema` (String) The Cedar schema in human-readable Cedar syntax.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the schema version was created (RFC 3339).
- `deprecated_at` (String) Timestamp when the schema version was deprecated (RFC 3339). Null unless deprecated.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this schema version is the zone's default.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status of the schema version: `active`, `deprecated`, or `archived`. New policy versions cannot be created against archived schemas.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the schema version was last updated (RFC 3339).
- `version` (String) Schema version string (e.g. `2026-02-24`).
